text:
Alex P: Quick heads-up — Lighthouse Labs showed a 28% drop in weekday active sessions over the last 7 days. Thinking a small 'Activation Lift' micro-play: short enablement + in-app nudges + soft-tier swap option.

CSM Bot: alert: account_health: Lighthouse Labs | score down 62 -> 48 | triggers: low-seq-usage, auth-2fa

Maria G: +1. Can we keep it lightweight? goal = re-engage 2 core flows they use, surface wins, and capture feedback.

Jordan L: Suggest a 10–15 min walkthrough + 1 targeted task checklist in-app. If they don't respond, trigger the soft-tier swap offer (no revenue hit, shorter term commitment).

Priya S: Draft cadence:
- Day 0: short check-in (email + in-app message) ✅
- Day 2: 10-min personalized walkthrough (calendar link)
- Day 5: quick usage tips + template playbook
- Day 10: soft-tier swap offer + feedback ask

Alex P: Email template (use subject A/B test):
```
Subject A: Quick check — 10 min to unlock X at Lighthouse Labs?
Hi {{first_name}}, saw a dip in X usage. Can we do a 10-min call to get you back to speed and show 2 quick wins?
```

Maria G: I'll own the walkthrough. Jordan will prep the in-app checklist (can we reuse the 'start-guide' flow?). Priya will own the offer messaging and tracking.

Jordan L: Will reuse start-guide and add a one-step 'complete flow' event. I'll add a KPI: +15% core-flow completion within 7 days for the cohort.

Priya S: Soft-tier swap copy: "Try the Essentials tier free for 30 days — if it helps hit your goals we'll switch back seamlessly." Also add an exit survey link to capture why they considered a tier change.

Alex P: Ops ask: @CSM Bot can you tag this account as 'activation-lift-pilot' and create a 14-day experiment? Track: DAU, core_flow_completion, NPS, survey_reason.

CSM Bot: done — tag applied, experiment created: activation-lift-pilot | window 14d

Maria G: Pilot plan = 3 mid-market accounts this week. I'll run Lighthouse Labs on Wed 10am PT. Everyone okay with owners and metrics?

Jordan L: OK from infra side.

Priya S: OK from offers.

Alex P: Great — we'll reconvene after pilot to iterate. If we hit re-engage >= 60% move to scaled run. Add notes to the shared playbook doc: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/activation-lift

Maria G: Quick note — capture verbatim feedback in the playbook and flag integration blockers separately.

Alex P: Thanks team :rocket:
